arStrings.szText: Enemies you kill while an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill is active grants a stack of Supremacy, each increasing your damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%1|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 0" * 100|x%1|]{/c}. When an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill ends, you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} stacks of Supremacy, but you begin to lose one stack every second.
